arguments.summary: Planning frame: assess NVDA and MU at the closed-market report time over 5, 21 and 63 completed sessions, separating issuer operating durability, explicitly hypothetical EPS/P-E sensitivities, dated market behavior versus SPY/XLK, macro transmission, policy/geopolitical constraints, and commodities/input channels. All five specialist roles are already pending and the independent Challenger is complete; no duplicate assignments are made. Final synthesis should reconcile their work into conditional bear/base/bull outcomes and decision-changing review conditions, rather than force a ranking.

claims.text: The latest completed-session observations are dated 2026-10-02: NVDA closed at $233.95 and MU at $1,074.89; the market was closed at the report clock, so neither is a current executable quote.

Both companies have dated annual reported diluted-EPS anchors and interim reported results, while the supplied data explicitly lack market-derived multiples and do not support automatic annualization or share-basis matching; valuation must therefore be expressed as transparent hypothetical sensitivities rather than consensus-based valuation.

The final decision should keep company-specific operating evidence distinct from shared global channels: rates and risk appetite can affect discounting and customer investment, policy can constrain addressable markets or supply, and commodity/input conditions can affect semiconductor cost structures; none of these channels alone establishes causality for a stock move.

gaps.description: No specialist research has yet been delivered in this planning stage. A relative preference between NVDA and MU cannot yet be formed because the required company operating-to-EPS bridges, macro, technical, geopolitical and commodity analyses—and reconciliation of the completed Challenger review—remain outstanding.

Current policy applicability and quantitative revenue/profit exposure by issuer are not established by the dated rule and partial filing excerpts. Final policy conclusions must be conditional unless the geopolitics research resolves applicability and exposure.

assumptions: The final assessment will use the recorded closed-market context and completed closes dated 2026-10-02, not IEX observations as consolidated executable quotes.
Company valuation cases will identify fiscal period, GAAP/share basis, residual EPS relative to reported interim earnings and management guidance, with EPS and P/E inputs labeled assumptions.

The planned decision is comparative only if specialist evidence supports comparison across business, valuation and market behavior; otherwise the final result will state decision boundaries without a ranking.
arguments.counter_thesis: Recent strength or reported earnings momentum may already embed demanding expectations, while policy, macro, supply-chain and cyclical-memory risks may dominate near-term returns. The planned work must test this rather than infer a preference from the supplied price history or hypothetical valuation asymmetry.

review_conditions.description: Reassess both instruments after the five specialist reports and Challenger findings are available; a change in the integrated operating-to-EPS bridge, policy applicability, market leadership across the stated session windows, or input-cost channel would change the conditional outlook or eliminate any otherwise tentative comparison.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Both are semiconductor companies exposed to the dated advanced-computing export-control environment and to broader trade-policy/supply-chain uncertainty. The available rule does not quantify either issuer's exposure or certify subsequent amendments, so this is a shared candidate risk channel rather than a quantified common factor.
shared_exposures.qualification: Issuer weights, product applicability and net financial effect are unmeasured at planning stage.

agent_report.work_summary: Defined the synthesis decision frame from the seeded completed-close, reported-EPS and dated-policy evidence, and checked role status. All five specialists are already assigned and Challenger is complete, so no duplicate research was routed or assigned.
main_conclusions: Use 5/21/63-session completed-price windows, not stale venue snapshots, for market behavior.
Keep hypothetical EPS/P-E sensitivities separate from reported results and from directional preference.
A final NVDA-versus-MU preference remains blocked pending the assigned specialist work and Challenger reconciliation.
Policy exposure is a conditional channel because current issuer-specific quantitative applicability is not established.
agent_report.short_summary: This is a research plan, not a directional call. It preserves the closed-market time boundary and focuses final synthesis on conditional, evidence-linked comparison.
limitations: No new source inspection or deterministic valuation calculation was performed in planning.
Specialist reports and the Challenger's substantive findings were not yet provided in this task context.
The dated policy source does not establish current complete law or financial exposure for either issuer.
